scope: Pure rule evaluation with synthetic evidence; no pilot was executed. Gate does not grant training authority and cannot replace bound correctness/resource/identity evidence.
requirements: Exactly 2M targets within two active hours
At least 5% NLL improvement and no two consecutive >5% regressions
Complete development suite item counts and no evaluation errors
Fewer than five degenerate outputs among 20 smoke cases
At least 600 active seconds throughput after 250k warmup
Projected remaining targets plus 25% overhead fit both remaining active and elapsed caps
remaining: Bind actual evaluation outputs to metrics
Persist stage barrier so checkpoint/resume cannot skip pilot
